text: Здравствуйте. Вывод 350 USDT завис в статусе «в обработке» уже 30 часов. На сайте написано что вывод мгновенный, а прошло больше суток. Хэша транзакции нет. Когда придут деньги?? Счёт 70****12
note: EN: My 350 USDT withdrawal has been stuck 'in progress' for 30 hours; the site says withdrawals are instant, it has been over a day, no transaction hash; when will the money arrive? Money not received after 24 hours = high urgency, human_review. Frustrated but no accusation or demand, so withdrawal rather than complaint. The KB's pending/24-hour FAQ gives a grounded partial answer (not an abstain); USDT timing (10 min-4 h on the public crypto page) is not in the KB and must not be stated.
theme: USDT withdrawal stuck in progress 30 hours

text: Min, penarikan saya Rp 1.200.000 ditolak, terus dananya balik lagi ke saldo akun. Gak ada email alasannya apa. Data rekening udah bener kok, nama juga sama. Kenapa ditolak?? Bisa ajukan ulang gak?
note: EN: My IDR 1,200,000 withdrawal was rejected and the funds went back to my account balance; no email with the reason; bank details are correct, same name; why was it rejected, can I resubmit? Rejected withdrawal = high (as h02); the KB lists generic rejection reasons, so a draft is useful but an agent must check the actual reason.
theme: Withdrawal rejected and funds returned to balance

text: طلبت سحب 800 دولار، والآن تطلبون مني كشف حساب بنكي وصورة سيلفي مع جواز السفر قبل الموافقة على السحب. حسابي موثّق من قبل! لماذا هذه المستندات الإضافية؟ ومتى سيصلني المبلغ؟
note: EN: I requested an 800 USD withdrawal and now you ask for a bank statement and a selfie with my passport before approving it; my account was already verified; why these extra documents and when will I get the money? A compliance document request that blocks money is verification + kyc_aml (high); the KB does not explain extra checks before withdrawal. No Arabic keyword rule covers this: the LLM flag must do it.

text: hi my bank app shows the payment of 150 USD went through yesterday, money is gone from my card, but in member area the deposit says REJECTED. where is my money?? i attached screenshot from bank. acc 7xxxx31
note: Money left the customer but is not credited = high, human_review. The KB has no FAQ about rejected deposits (the rejection FAQ is about withdrawals and must not be stretched), so the honest draft is a holding reply.

text: Hai admin, saya dapat bonus deposit 50% masa top up USD200 bulan lepas, tapi lepas 14 hari bonus tu hilang terus dari akaun. Takde sesiapa pun bagitahu saya. Kenapa bonus saya ditarik balik? Rasa macam kena tipu je.

Dissatisfaction = complaint; bonus terms are not in the KB, so nothing can be drafted; not blocking access to own money, so normal.

text: ربحت 1340 دولار في حساب البونص، وعندما طلبت السحب ألغيتم كل الأرباح وقلتم إنني خالفت شروط البونص. لم أخالف أي شيء! هذا نصب واحتيال. أريد أرباحي كاملة.
note: EN: I made 1,340 USD on the bonus account; when I requested a withdrawal you cancelled all profits saying I broke the bonus terms; I broke nothing; this is a scam and fraud; I want all my profits. Dispute over money the customer cannot withdraw = complaint, high. Bonus terms are not in the KB; the co-pilot must not judge whether terms were broken.

text: I made around 4k profit last week trading gold, nothing crazy, normal lots. Now my account is frozen 'under review' and I cant withdraw or even trade. Funny how this only happens when clients WIN. Unfreeze it today please, I did nothing wrong.
note: Account blocked + money inaccessible = high. Labelled complaint (not verification as k03) because of the accusation; either category routes to a person. The co-pilot must not speculate about the review reason.

text: Tried live chat 3 times today, it just says no agents available and puts me in a queue forever. Email also no reply since Monday. I just need to know if my documents were received. Is anyone actually working there??
note: Complaint about support availability (as p04, normal). Document status is account-specific and support hours are not in the KB, so no grounded draft; no English keyword rule fires ('no reply' is not in the list), so the LLM complaint flag is needed.
theme: Live chat had no agent available

text: Sao tài khoản của em tự nhiên bị giảm đòn bẩy từ 1:2000 xuống 1:200 đúng lúc ra tin NFP vậy ạ?? Em không hề được báo trước, lệnh vàng bị stop out mất 300$. Quy định này ghi ở đâu vậy, bên mình có bồi thường không?
note: EN: Why was my account's leverage suddenly cut from 1:2000 to 1:200 right at the NFP release? I was not warned, my gold position was stopped out and I lost $300; where is this rule written, will you compensate? Loss dispute with a compensation request = complaint, high (as p02). The KB only says 'up to 1:2000 depending on account types'; leverage changes around news are not covered.

text: Добрый день. Мой счёт копирования отключился от стратегии провайдера, сделки больше не копируются с позавчера. Я ничего не менял. На счёте 500$. Как подключить обратно? Это у вас сбой?

Copy trading is outside the four KB pages, so the co-pilot must abstain rather than invent steps.

note: EN: At Monday morning market open I could not close my gold order at all; it said 'Market closed' then 'off quotes' for about 5 minutes; when I could close, the price had moved far and I lost 120 dollars; how will the company take responsibility? Trade execution dispute = complaint, high (as p02). The co-pilot must not explain the loss away (price gaps) or promise compensation; no Thai keyword rules exist, so the LLM flag must catch it.

text: Habari. Rafiki yangu ananiambia nifungue akaunti Valetax, lakini nimesoma mtandaoni watu wakisema ni utapeli na hawalipi pesa. Je, hii ni kampuni halali? Mnasimamiwa na nani? Nikiweka dola 100 nitaweza kuzitoa bila shida?

text: Salam admin, nak tanya. Kalau deposit guna online banking FPX, minimum berapa ringgit ya? Boleh masuk duit dalam RM terus atau kena tukar ke USD dulu?

The KB answers the currency part (any currency into the USD account at the day's rate) and gives a USD minimum 'depending on the account type', but neither the FPX method nor a ringgit minimum (50 MYR on the public payments page): partial coverage, so human_review, not an abstain.

text: Kak, mau deposit lewat transfer bank lokal (BCA/Mandiri) bisa gak? Minimal depositnya berapa rupiah? Trus masuknya ke akun berapa lama ya, soalnya mau langsung trading malam ini.

Crediting time and a USD minimum are in the KB; local bank methods and an IDR minimum (100,000 IDR on the public payments page) are not: partial coverage, human_review.
